verses.text: Of David. Do not fret over those who do evil; do not envy those who do wrong.

segments.text: Of David. Do not fret over those who do evil; do not envy those who do wrong.

verses.text: For they wither quickly like grass and wilt like tender plants.

segments.text: For they wither quickly like grass and wilt like tender plants.

verses.text: Trust in the LORD and do good; dwell in the land and cultivate faithfulness.

segments.text: Trust in the LORD and do good; dwell in the land and cultivate faithfulness.

verses.text: Delight yourself in the LORD, and He will give you the desires of your heart.

verses.text: Commit your way to the LORD; trust in Him, and He will do it.

verses.text: He will bring forth your righteousness like the dawn, your justice like the noonday sun.

verses.text: Be still before the LORD and wait patiently for Him; do not fret when men prosper in their ways, when they carry out wicked schemes.

segments.text: Be still before the LORD and wait patiently for Him; do not fret when men prosper in their ways, when they carry out wicked schemes.

verses.text: Refrain from anger and abandon wrath; do not fret—it can only bring harm.

verses.text: For the evildoers will be cut off, but those who hope in the LORD will inherit the land.

segments.text: For the evildoers will be cut off, but those who hope in the LORD will inherit the land.

verses.text: Yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more; though you look for them, they will not be found.

verses.text: But the meek will inherit the land and delight in abundant prosperity.

verses.text: The wicked scheme against the righteous and gnash their teeth at them,

verses.text: The wicked have drawn the sword and bent the bow to bring down the poor and needy, to slay those whose ways are upright.

verses.text: But their swords will pierce their own hearts, and their bows will be broken.

verses.text: Better is the little of the righteous than the abundance of many who are wicked.

verses.text: For the arms of the wicked will be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.

verses.text: The LORD knows the days of the blameless, and their inheritance will last forever.

verses.text: In the time of evil they will not be ashamed, and in the days of famine they will be satisfied.

verses.text: But the wicked and enemies of the LORD will perish like the glory of the fields. They will vanish; like smoke they will fade away.

verses.text: The wicked borrow and do not repay, but the righteous are gracious and giving.

verses.text: Surely those He blesses will inherit the land, but the cursed will be destroyed.

verses.text: The steps of a man are ordered by the LORD who takes delight in his journey.

verses.text: Though he falls, he will not be overwhelmed, for the LORD is holding his hand.

verses.text: I once was young and now am old, yet never have I seen the righteous abandoned or their children begging for bread.

segments.text: I once was young and now am old, yet never have I seen the righteous abandoned or their children begging for bread.

verses.text: They are ever generous and quick to lend, and their children are a blessing.

verses.text: Turn away from evil and do good, so that you will abide forever.

segments.text: Turn away from evil and do good, so that you will abide forever.

verses.text: For the LORD loves justice and will not forsake His saints. They are preserved forever, but the offspring of the wicked will be cut off.

verses.text: Wait for the LORD and keep His way, and He will raise you up to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you will see it.
